terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, SHA-256, HTTPS, NTFS, ReFS, GDI, PNG, JPEG, executable names, paths, switches, URLs and placeholders remain untranslated.
A saved screenshot or clip is un'acquisizione; the domain verb is acquisire. Take screenshot stays the natural catturare uno screenshot because the English verb there is take, not capture.
Controller input detection is rilevamento dell'input and never reuses the media term acquisizione.

Gesture names form one series: press=Pressione, tap=Pressione breve, double tap=Doppia pressione, triple tap=Tripla pressione, hold=Pressione prolungata. Timing windows are intervalli, never finestre.
Timing presets name behaviour, not speed alone: 200 ms (rapido) against 500 ms (tollerante).
Toggle labels state their effect: Aggiungi/rimuovi dai preferiti for the favorite action, Attiva/disattiva for surface toggles such as overlay and barra laterale.
galleria, libreria, overlay, barra laterale and area di notifica stay distinct; the Windows tray is area di notifica, never vassoio.
replay, buffer di replay, clip, registrazione, riproduzione and screenshot denote distinct media concepts; replay is never tradotto as ripetizione.
Database terminology uses chiave esterna, schema, integrità, transazione, riga, array and stringa; string is never corda.
Update security uses manifest, checksum, SHA-256, firma, attendibilità, HTTPS and staging; staged is in staging, never messo in scena.
Internal transactional publish operations use rendere definitivo or finalizzare rather than the public-facing pubblicare.
GameInput uses runtime GameInput and a safe ripiego sul meccanismo legacy, which names the fallback path rather than old hardware.
archiviazione is used for storage; stoccaggio is warehouse vocabulary and is not used.
